225:t_016:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll submit the details as data later, but it seems that overcoming the end-of-the-universe crisis that comes once every 12,000 years is not impossible.」

225:t_016:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's what I figured. I've never heard of the universe being destroyed 12,000 years ago in any parallel world, either.」

225:t_016:11.en:
$n
「...I'm sure I'm thinking the same thing as $$セツコ$$...」

225:t_016:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
(A world that overcame the once-in-12,000-years crisis definitely exists...)

225:t_016:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
(But the once-in-120-million-years crisis will drag in every parallel world...)

225:t_017:0.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain, we have a call from $$バトル７$$! They're struggling against enemy reinforcements! They're requesting immediate assistance!」

225:t_017:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「N-No...! It's... the $$サイデリアル$$!」

225:t_018:0.en:
$$ファ$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ have broken through the defense line!」

225:t_018:1.en:
$$エマ$$
「Pursue them, hurry! If the ruins take any more attacks, the survey team won't hold out!」

225:t_019:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「I've got $$ランカ$$ on board...! I'll protect her no matter what!」

225:t_019:3.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Thank you, $$アルト$$... For now, I'll just let myself be happy...)

225:t_020:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Third kill confirmed. Moving on to the next target.」

225:t_020:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Sorry, $$ランカ$$. Just bear with it a little longer.」

225:t_020:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「But I promise. I will protect you, no matter what.」

225:t_100:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$ランカ$$'s behind me...! I'll protect her no matter what!)

225:t_100:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(My wings exist to protect them! I'll do it!)

225:t_101:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
($$ランカ$$... I'm not a man who deserves to be called your brother.)

225:t_101:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(But I will protect you, at least...! Even at the cost of my life!)

225:t_102:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「All right, all right, $$ガムリン$$! Your burning heart is getting through to me!」

225:t_102:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Same here, $$バサラ$$! Your heart fires me up!」

225:t_102:3.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
(They're both good men. Looks like you'll have a hard time choosing, $$ミレーヌ$$.)

225:t_103:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Even in that talk with the $$プロトカルチャー$$, there was no answer to our anxiety...)

225:t_103:2.en:
$n
(The true end that comes once every 120 million years... the great collapse... But surely that's not all...)

225:t_103:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
(What is waiting there...? What are we so afraid of...?)
